blocks.text: Surrey Mobile Homes for Sale | Manufactured Homes MLS Listings

parts.t: Surrey mobile homes and manufactured homes offer one of the most affordable ways to own property in the Fraser Valley. Whether you're looking for a home in a 55+ community, a downsizer-friendly layout, or an entry-level option for first-time buyers, Surrey has a variety of mobile home parks and manufactured housing communities to choose from.

Browse the latest Surrey mobile homes for sale below, including properties in South Surrey, Newton, and surrounding areas. Listings are updated regularly and include current prices, photos, park information and property details.
If you're considering buying or selling a mobile or manufactured home in Surrey, contact Jared Gibbons for expert local guidance and up-to-date market insight.

blocks.text: Affordable Homeownership Options in Surrey’s Mobile Home Communities

parts.t: Mobile home communities in Surrey offer one of the most affordable paths into homeownership while still providing independence and a sense of community. Many parks are located in convenient areas close to shopping, transit, and everyday amenities, making them especially attractive for downsizers, retirees, and budget-conscious buyers.

Homes often feature private outdoor space, parking, and lower monthly costs compared to condos or townhomes. Demand for mobile homes has been steadily growing due to their value and accessibility in a competitive market. If you’re exploring options in Surrey’s manufactured home communities, I can help you compare parks, understand pad fees, and stay updated on new listings and recent sales.
Can't find what you're looking for? Jared can search the full MLS® for you.
